data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum that has raised $10.6M to date. The broader frontier-tech climate sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including established names such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the narrower peer set of same-stage and adjacent-stage companies in this sector proved insufficient—zero datapoints met tight stage and valuation-tier filters—making a traditional peer-median approach inapplicable.

The valuation analysis therefore relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $10.6M total capital raised (used as a proxy for current valuation). This yields an implied valuation of $26.5M. A conservative range around this single-method result—accounting for execution risk and the limited peer dataset—spans $23M to $30M.

The $26M median valuation reflects standard Seed-stage progression dynamics but carries material uncertainty given the absence of tightly comparable Seed-stage benchmarks in the Climate & Energy frontier space. Key variables affecting the realized valuation will include technology de-risking, customer traction, and market conditions at the next financing event. The analysis would benefit from additional same-stage peers or milestones achieved since the most recent raise.
